Trinamics is a well-known, specialised name in technical recruitment in the Netherlands, among candidates and clients alike. Our client is a global health technology company with a large R&D site in the Eindhoven region. Development teams in the Netherlands work closely with colleagues in India and other countries.

What you’ll do
You join the Systems Engineering department within the interventional applications R&D organisation. The team covers system design, system verification, usability and validation. Turn system requirements into clear, measurable test cases (often automated) that cover functionality, interactions and edge cases

Help build test automation frameworks and reusable test scripts
Guide junior colleagues in the team and share your knowledge of testing methods and tools
This is a senior position. You bring structure to the work and are comfortable in a regulated development environment.

What you bring
A degree in Engineering or equivalent
Several years of experience verifying medical device software, Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), or software in another regulated domain
Experience with requirement-based verification, risk-based testing, system integration testing and release verification
Experience with Behavior Driven Development, defect triage and test management systems
Experience with test automation and applying AI in testing
Experience with X-ray systems and/or image quality testing is a strong plus
Fluent English

What’s on offer
A senior testing role on interventional X-ray systems that directly affect patient care
A secondment through Trinamics with a real prospect of a direct contract with the client
Employment conditions equal to the client’s, including vacation days in line with the client’s collective labour agreement
Hybrid working: on average three days at the office and two days from home
